title: vaccinium lanceolatum
intro: Vaccinium lanceolatum, commonly known as the huckleberry, is a type of shrub that belongs to the heath family. This plant is rich in nutrients and offers various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Vaccinium lanceolatum include its ability to support cardiovascular health, boost the immune system, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
